name: weekly-maintenance
prompt:
Weekly maintenance. Work through each step, then reply with one short summary (a few bullets, under 800 characters).

1. Memory – reconcile all of ~/.claude/projects/-app/memory following the Memory section in CLAUDE.md, and merge duplicates. When unsure, check transcripts from the last 30 days (~/.claude/projects/-app/*.jsonl), and drop time-sensitive facts (prices, holdings, versions) that you can't confirm.
2. Layout – follow the Data Locations convention in CLAUDE.md. Move git clones in the /data root into /data/repos/ (skip any with uncommitted changes and mention them). Move other loose files and directories in the /data root into /data/tmp/. Never move anything listed in Data Locations, or lost+found.
3. Cleanup – `find /data/tmp /data/outbox /data/media /data/attachments -mindepth 1 -mtime +7 -delete` (ignore missing directories), then remove empty directories left behind.
4. pnpm store – `pnpm store prune --store-dir /data/.pnpm-store`.

Report memory changes, files moved, and disk space reclaimed (`du -sh /data` before and after).
